'''WXYZ''' may refer to:

* The last four letters of the [[English alphabet]]
;In broadcasting, the following stations
* [[WXYZ-TV]], an ABC-affiliated television station (channel 25, virtual 7) licensed to serve Detroit, Michigan, United States
* [[WXYT (AM)]], a radio station (1270 AM) licensed to serve Detroit, which held the call sign WXYZ from 1930 to 1984
* [[WRIF]], a radio station (101.1 FM) licensed to serve Detroit, which held the call sign WXYZ-FM from 1948 to 1971

{{disambig|callsign}}

'''KNRS''' may refer to:
* [[Veteran#Britain|King's National Roll Scheme]], aid to disabled British veterans of the First world War
* [[KNRS-FM]], an FM radio station in Centerville, Utah, United States
* [[KNRS (AM)]], an AM radio station in Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
* The ICAO code for [[Naval Outlying Landing Field Imperial Beach]] in Imperial Beach, California, United States

KUBL (1995–2000) | affiliations = [[Westwood One]] | owner = [[Cumulus Media]] | licensee = Radio License Holding CBC, LLC | sister_stations = [[KBEE]], [[KBER]], [[KENZ (FM)|KENZ]], [[KHTB]], [[KKAT (AM)|KKAT]] | webcast = {{listen live|https://player.listenlive.co/25911}} | website = [https://www.933thebull.com 933thebull.com] | licensing_authority= [[Federal Communications Commission|FCC]] }} '''KUBL-FM''' (93.3 [[Hertz|MHz]]) is a [[commercial radio|commercial]] [[radio station]] in [[Salt Lake City|Salt Lake City, Utah]], branded as “93.3 The Bull“.{{Cite web |date=2022-09-13 |title=KUBL Rebrands As 93.3 The Bull - RadioInsight |url=https://radioinsight.com/headlines/241847/kubl-rebrands-as-93-3-the-bull/ |access-date=2023-03-14 |language=en-US}} It is owned by [[Cumulus Media]] and it broadcasts a [[country music]] [[radio format|format]]. The studios are on Bearcat Drive near the [[Interstate 15|I-15]]/[[Interstate 80|I-80]] interchange in [[South Salt Lake]].[https://media-cdn.socastsrm.com/wordpress/wp-content/blogs.dir/3389/files/2025/08/official-rules-kbee-question-impossible-week-of-82525.pdf "KBEE Contest Rules"] KUBL-FM has an [[effective radiated power]] (ERP) of 25,000 [[watt]]s. Its [[transmitter]] site is in [[Erda, Utah|Erda]], southwest of the city on [[Farnsworth Peak]] in the [[Oquirrh Mountains]].[https://radio-locator.com/cgi-bin/finder?sr=Y&s=C&call=KUBL&nav=home Radio-Locator.com/KUBL]
